title: Periodic Quarter-Wave Bragg Stack for UV Reflection
scientific_hypothesis: A periodic quarter-wave Bragg stack centered at 375 nm (mid-UV band) using HfO2/SiO2 pairs will achieve high reflection in 300-450 nm while maintaining adequate transmission in 1000-1700 nm due to the natural transparency of dielectric stacks outside their stopband.
design_principle: Quarter-wave optical thickness layers at the center wavelength of the reflection band create constructive interference for reflection. Outside the stopband, the stack becomes increasingly transparent as wavelength increases, potentially allowing SWIR transmission.
proposed_topology: air / hfo2 / sio2 / hfo2 / sio2 / hfo2 / sio2 / hfo2 / sio2 / hfo2 / sio2 / hfo2 / sio2 / hfo2 / sio2 / hfo2 / sio2 / hfo2 / sio2 / hfo2 / sio2 / sio2_substrate
design_variables: individual layer thicknesses for all 20 coating layers
soft_objectives: minimize layer count while meeting spectral targets
manufacturing_considerations: HfO2 and SiO2 are standard ion-beam sputtering materials
quarter-wave thicknesses at 375 nm are approximately 50-70 nm per layer, manufacturable
theory_basis: Transfer matrix method for multilayer interference
expected_advantages: Low layer count leaves margin for optimization
known_risks: May not achieve sufficient SWIR transmission if stopband extends too far
UV reflection bandwidth may be narrower than 300-450 nm requirement
execution_request_english: Design a 20-layer periodic dielectric coating on fused silica substrate with air incidence. Stack sequence: air / hfo2 / SiO2 (Lemarchand) / hfo2 / SiO2 (Lemarchand) / hfo2 / SiO2 (Lemarchand) / hfo2 / SiO2 (Lemarchand) / hfo2 / SiO2 (Lemarchand) / hfo2 / SiO2 (Lemarchand) / hfo2 / SiO2 (Lemarchand) / hfo2 / SiO2 (Lemarchand) / hfo2 / SiO2 (Lemarchand) / hfo2 / SiO2 (Lemarchand) / SiO2 (Lemarchand)_substrate. Optimize all 20 layer thicknesses to maximize transmittance in 1000-1700 nm band and maximize reflectance in 300-450 nm band. Use only hfo2 and SiO2 (Lemarchand) materials. Maximum 30 layers constraint satisfied with 20 layers.
